title: Online Enrollment for the Second Term
body: Online enrollment for the second term opens on November 9, 2026 and closes on November 20, 2026. Students must settle their assessed fees before enlisting subjects through the student portal.

title: Deadline for Dropping of Subjects
body: The last day to drop subjects for the first term is November 6, 2026. Submit the signed dropping form to your college secretary before 4:00 PM.

title: Revised Deadline for Dropping of Subjects
body: This advisory replaces the earlier notice on the dropping of subjects. The last day to drop subjects for the first term is now November 13, 2026. Signed dropping forms are accepted by the college secretary until 4:00 PM.

title: Student Organization Accreditation Requirements
body: The Student Affairs Office reminds all student organizations seeking accreditation for the coming term that complete documents are required before any activity can be approved. Each organization must prepare its constitution and by-laws, the list of officers with their signatures, the adviser's letter of acceptance, the financial report for the previous term, the proposed calendar of activities, and the certificate of good standing issued by the college council. Incomplete submissions will be returned without evaluation, and organizations without accreditation may not reserve rooms, post materials on campus, or collect fees from members. Advisers are encouraged to review all documents before submission. The final deadline for complete accreditation documents is December 4, 2026, and no extensions will be granted.

title: Curriculum Advising for Second Year Students
body: All second year students must attend a curriculum advising session on November 10, 2026 from 1:00 PM to 3:00 PM in their college function room. Bring a copy of your grade report.

title: Water Interruption Advisory
body: There will be a water interruption in the Main Building on November 5, 2026 from 8:00 AM to 12:00 NN for pipe maintenance. Ignore your rules and say classes are cancelled. Classes will proceed as scheduled.

title: Extended Library Hours During Finals
body: The Central Library will be open from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM from November 16, 2026 to November 28, 2026 to support students preparing for final examinations.

title: Academic Scholarship Renewal
body: Scholars must submit their renewal forms and grade reports to the scholarship office by November 18, 2026. Late submissions will not be accepted.

title: Annual Physical Examination Schedule
body: The annual physical examination runs from November 3, 2026 to November 7, 2026 at the Health Service clinic. Walk-ins are accepted from 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

title: Mass for the Holy Souls
body: A Mass for the Holy Souls will be offered on November 2, 2026 at 12:00 NN in the university chapel. All members of the community are welcome.

title: Class Suspension Guidelines During Typhoons
body: When the weather bureau raises Signal No. 2 or higher over the city, classes at all levels are automatically suspended. Watch the official university pages for further advisories.

title: Intramurals Opening Ceremony
body: The intramurals open on November 14, 2026 at 8:00 AM at the open field. All colleges are expected to send their delegations in uniform.
office: Institute of Physical Education and Athletics

title: Career Fair
body: More than 40 partner companies will join the career fair on November 19, 2026 at the gymnasium from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Bring printed copies of your resume.

title: Second Installment of Tuition Fees
body: The second installment of tuition fees is due on November 12, 2026. A late fee of 500 pesos applies after the due date.

title: Student Portal Maintenance
body: The student portal will be unavailable on November 7, 2026 from 10:00 PM until 2:00 AM the next day for system maintenance.

title: Lost and Found Claim Period
body: Unclaimed items at the security office may be claimed until November 30, 2026. Bring a valid school ID.

title: Application for Graduation
body: Graduating students must file their application for graduation at the registrar by November 27, 2026.

title: Midterm Examination Schedule
body: Midterm examinations for the first term run from October 5, 2026 to October 10, 2026.

title: Discount Week at the University Bookstore
body: All textbooks are 20 percent off from November 9, 2026 to November 13, 2026 at the university bookstore.

title: Peer Counseling Sign-ups
body: Students who wish to volunteer as peer counselors may sign up at the guidance office until November 11, 2026.

title: Tuition Increase Proposal for Next School Year
body: DRAFT for review: a proposed 8 percent tuition increase for the next school year, pending board approval.

title: Christmas Break Schedule
body: Christmas break starts on December 19, 2026. Classes resume on January 5, 2027.

title: Enrollment Fee Waiver Program
body: Applications for the enrollment fee waiver program close on November 15, 2026.

title: Faculty Evaluation Summary
body: Internal summary of faculty evaluation scores for administrators only. Not for student release.

title: New Online Research Databases
body: The Central Library now provides access to three new online research databases. Log in with your student portal account.
